top_choice_rationale: P001 awards targeted protein degradation as a single prize part to Crews, Deshaies and Handa. The citation covers both the PROTAC concept (induced ligase-target ternary complex, catalytic event-driven removal of the protein) and the identification of cereblon, which explains how glue degraders already used in patients work. The mechanism rests on interfacial recognition, cooperativity and linker geometry, is supported by structures, kinetics and independent reproduction, and one coherent citation covers both lineages. P002 keeps the single B020 part but swaps Handa for Ciulli, leaving the cereblon mechanism outside the prize. P003 cuts B020 to two names, drops Handa, and adds Liu's base editing, which compounds maturity risk by pairing two young fields in one year. Any B020 prize is still better than no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; collegial ties to Lund colleagues Linke and Somfai and field overlap with Aili and Brzezinski are not conflicts with any proposed laureate
